posts.title: Chatroom
posts.description: Update: I'll be retiring the chat by the end of this year. It was a fun little idea, but ultimately not really used, so I'll move on to other things. Thank you! I'm testing a new feature, just for fun. Little chatroom to say hello to everyone, share ideas or personal projects? If it's too much for me to moderate, I'll pull it down, but for now let's see how it goes. I hope you all enjoy, and I see
